name: List-price dollarization
summary: Every dollar = usage_quantity x pricing.effective_list.default from the price row active at usage_end_time; unpriced usage stays quantity, never $0.

name: Discount what-if
summary: discount_pct never changes a stored dollar; each list-price column gets a `_disc` twin = col x (1 - discount_pct), labelled what-if.

name: Actual vs list not assessable
summary: system.billing has no negotiated rate, so cost_actual_vs_list_by_sku always reads NOT_ASSESSED (no_negotiated_rate_source).

name: Cost allocation split
summary: A warehouse-day's DBUs split per query-tag set by attributed DBUs (split_f = LEAST(attr, billed)/billed) plus an idle/unsplit remainder; other rows are one part with latest job/pipeline tags.

name: Cost unit tags by level
summary: Each cost unit lists real tag values at compute (bill), work (job/pipeline/query) and workspace (inferred, by day) levels; untagged remainders are derived at request time.

name: Cost reconciliation
summary: Billing total recomputed straight from billing.usage must match tags.cost_unit within $0.005 per window and unit.

name: Nested tag rollup
summary: For one key each unit's dollar takes the first real value walking work -> compute -> workspace, else __untagged__ at account level; tree, by_value and untagged metrics follow.

name: Top tag values per level
summary: Top values of one key are ranked per level and never merged; rows overlap across levels, only tagged = total - untagged reconciles.

name: Untagged spend split
summary: Untagged dollars split into units carrying other non-platform tags (rename/merge) and units with no tags (tag them).

name: Tag key normalisation and sentinels
summary: Tag keys compare after lower-case and removing spaces, _ and -; __untagged__, __mixed__, __none__, __empty__ are reserved sentinels, never real values.

name: Workspace tag inference
summary: A workspace's daily tag value is the top billed value when key coverage >= coverage_floor and top share >= share_floor, else __mixed__ or __untagged__; versions need 3 days.

name: Top tags
summary: tag_aliases.yml top_tags names up to 4 validated keys with display names for Spend-by headlines and workspace filters; a broken file hides them.

name: Tag filter semantics
summary: Values of one key OR, different keys AND; a bare key means any real value; __untagged__ means no value at any level; a filter is never half-applied.

name: Tag chain per finding
summary: A non-spend check is tag-filtered through an ordered chain of tag_entity lookups built from its own columns: query, job/pipeline, endpoint, compute, UC object, workspace.

name: Spend checks under a tag filter
summary: A billed dollar belongs to a tag value by its most specific tag (work, compute, workspace by day); spend checks re-run over exactly those dollars via tag_spend variants.

name: Bill tags override perf compute tags
summary: The bill's tag on a warehouse's or cluster's last billed day replaces its own value at the compute level of tags.perf_unit_tag.

name: Mandatory tag compliance
summary: Each mandatory key is looked for level by level (own, job, compute/bill, workspace); the first level gets credit; missing everywhere is truly missing.

name: Effective status
summary: At read time admin-group grants and rows under the materiality floor (USD scaled by window/30) move CRITICAL/WARN to OK; trend reports cap CRITICAL at WARN.

name: Finding money and affected count
summary: A check's card shows one dollar figure summed over flagged rows (all rows for a spend ranking), once per parent job, discounted, and N of M distinct flagged objects.

name: Possible waste total
summary: Waste total = est_wasted_usd_list of flagged waste-check rows, once per resource, x (1 - discount); fallbacks shown not added; below-floor kept separate.

name: Per-statement cost split
summary: A statement costs its attributed_usage DBUs at list price when the warehouse has attribution, else its task-time share of each billed hour; failed statements' share is possible waste.

name: Period-over-period spend change
summary: Last N days vs the N before per workspace and product: >= 25% WARN, >= 50% or from zero CRITICAL, only when current >= $50, fully priced and history covers both windows.

name: Oversized job saving estimate
summary: Oversized when CPU p90 < 30 and memory peak < 40 with no swap over >= 3 telemetry runs; saving = job list cost x 0.5 if both under half, else x 0.25.

name: Threshold precedence
summary: A check's :param resolves thresholds.yml[query_id], then [_all], then the header default; baked into the export SQL.

name: Workspace environment mapping
summary: Environment = workspace name lower-cased, -_./ as spaces, whole-word matched prod then uat then dev; else unknown; a seed override wins.

name: User identity masking
summary: When on, a person's identity reads '<real id or sha256[:8]> <first 2>***'; NULL, __REDACTED__, GUIDs and masked values pass through.

name: Row-level security
summary: A user sees a row only if one grant passes on every configured column ('*' = all); NULL/'0' rows need '*'; any load error or unknown user sees nothing.

name: Data usage class and indexes
summary: One usage class per table (written-never-read, idle 90d+, cooling, active); log-scaled complexity and usage indexes per workspace, catalog or schema; signal from both.

name: Databricks to DuckDB translation
summary: 25 ordered rewrite rules turn a vendored body into DuckDB SQL without touching literals, comments or sentinel tokens; leftovers raise Untranslatable.

name: Query registry and library corrections
summary: A query is a finding when healthy is not 'n/a -' and its body emits AS status; vendored defects are disclosed from a validated corrections register.
